subject: science
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Heredity) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts trait cards (based on described inheritance patterns) into dominant and recessive categories
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described trait outcome to whether it reflects a dominant or recessive allele
exercise.abstract: Student explains the difference between a dominant and a recessive trait

misconception_flags: believes a recessive trait is somehow weaker or less common by definition rather than requiring two copies to be expressed

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
